sloka: त्रिकूटस्थः स तु तदा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः ।प्रेषयामास दौत्येन प्रहस्तं वाक्यकोविदम् ।। ७.११.२२ ॥
transliteration: trikūṭasthaḥ sa tu tadā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ ।preṣayāmāsa dautyena prahastaṁ vākyakovidam ।। 7.11.22 ॥

translations.english: Then, Ravana, the night-wanderer, who was situated on Trikuta mountain, sent Prahasta, who was skilled in speech, as an envoy.
